products.name: Turntable Platform Trolley
products.summary: Heavy-duty platform trolley with a turntable front assembly for easy steering of heavy loads.
features: The platform is fabricated from a single piece of M.S. sheet, bent in six folds to form a “C” channel at the ends, with “U” grooves on the top surface for a neat appearance.
The platform is ribbed underneath with additional “C” channels for extra strength.
The push–pull handle is made from heavy M.S. round pipe and bolted on top of the platform.
Fitted with 2 fixed castors and 2 wheels mounted on a heavy-duty turntable assembly.
The turntable assembly combines a thrust bearing with a taper roller bearing for easy steering under heavy loads.
The compact turntable assembly with spring-loaded handle improves the manoeuvrability of the trolley and reduces pulling effort by about 30 %.
Widely used for moving corrugated boxes, gunny bags, heavy materials, crates, etc. within factories, godowns, stores and warehouses.

products.name: Coolant Feeding Trolley
products.summary: Mobile coolant tank with electric pump, rotary hand pump and level indicator for feeding machine tools.
features: The base is fabricated from a single piece of M.S. sheet, bent to form a “C” channel at the ends and ribbed underneath with angles.
The coolant tank is fabricated above the base from thick M.S. sheet and welded on all sides to make it leak-proof.

Also fitted with a rotary hand pump and an A4-size drawing pocket.

products.name: CNC Tool Trolley – 600 × 5
products.summary: CNC tool trolley with a 600 × 600 mm platform and 5 adjustable tool pocket trays for BT 30, BT 40 or BT 50 tool holders; load capacity 200 kg.
features: Trolley size 600 × 5 = 600 × 600 mm platform with 5 tool pocket trays.
Fabricated from a single piece of M.S. sheet, bent in six folds to form a “C” channel at the ends, with “U” grooves on the top surface; ribbed underneath with additional “C” channels for strength.
“A” shape (taper shape) for easy access to all tools; gives instant tool identification and systematic tool storage.

Fitted with 2 fixed and 2 swivel castors; 1 swivel castor has a parking brake for safety.

products.name: Bin Trolley – Single Sided
products.summary: Single-sided bin trolley holding 24, 20 or 16 bins depending on bin size; load capacity 300 kg.
features: Single-sided bin storage trolley for systematic storage and movement of material in bins, with instant identification of the stored material.
Vertical tubes with holes at 50 mm pitch let the bin trays be re-positioned to suit your requirement.
Bin trays are made from a single piece of M.S. sheet, ribbed at the sides and back for strength; available in 3 bin sizes.
Push–pull handle made from heavy M.S. round pipe, welded on top of the trolley.
Used on shop floors as mini stores, on assembly lines and for storing components.
All castor wheels with ball bearings; 1 swivel castor has a parking brake for safety.
products.brake_text: 1 swivel castor is fitted with a parking brake for safety.

products.name: Mobile Access Steps
products.summary: Welded steel mobile access steps with 1000, 2000, 3000 or 4000 mm platform height and a 1000 mm safety railing; load capacity 300 kg.
features: The base is fabricated from M.S. rectangular tube and fitted with 2 fixed and 2 swivel castors; 1 swivel castor has a parking brake for safety.
The top structure is fabricated from M.S. round pipes, with a 1000 mm high safety railing around the top platform for operator safety.
Welded steel access steps designed to reach difficult places.
All castor wheels are fitted with ball bearings.
products.brake_text: 1 swivel castor is fitted with brakes for safety.
notes: Please check that the selected unit leaves sufficient head space for working.
